methodology.frequency: Every five trading sessions; signals at close and executions at next available adjusted open
methodology.portfolio: Top 10 equal target weights from Minervini template + 3/6/12-month price relative-strength score
methodology.regime: SPY 200-day +/-3% hysteresis; inactive regime targets cash
methodology.universe: Supplied market-cap Top 500 of year t applied during year t+1

dataWarning: Yahoo adjusted-price proxy. STX cache ends on 2025-12-31; 2026 target portfolios remain valid signal lists but realized holdings and returns after that date are not used for performance reporting.
